# Self Custody Labs

> Independent, vendor-neutral guides to Bitcoin self-custody: cold storage,
> hardware wallets, seed phrases, multisig, running your own node, and privacy.
> No affiliate links and no sponsored placement. Every page below is also
> available as Markdown by appending .md to its URL.

- [What is Bitcoin Self-Custody?](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/fundamentals/what-is-self-custody.md): Learn what Bitcoin self-custody means: controlling your own private keys, seed phrases, and taking full ownership of your Bitcoin without third parties.
- [Why Holding Your Own Bitcoin Matters](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/fundamentals/holding-bitcoin.md): Understand the difference between holding Bitcoin yourself vs on an exchange. Learn why 'not your keys, not your coins' is essential for true ownership.
- [Choose Your Self-Custody Setup](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/fundamentals/choosing-your-path.md): Interactive decision tree to help you choose the right Bitcoin self-custody setup based on your holdings, technical comfort, and security needs.
- [Assess Your Threat Model](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/fundamentals/threat-models.md): Determine what level of Bitcoin security you actually need. Match your setup to your real risks. Not everyone needs maximum security, but some people do.
- [Bitcoin Keys: Private Keys, Seeds, Derivation Paths](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys.md): Learn how Bitcoin keys work: private keys, seed phrases (BIP39), extended keys (xpub/xprv), and derivation paths. The foundation of Bitcoin ownership.
- [Understanding Bitcoin Private Keys](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/intro.md): Learn what Bitcoin private keys are, how they work, and why they're essential for controlling your Bitcoin. The foundation of self-custody explained.
- [Bitcoin Seed Phrases Explained (BIP39)](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/seed.md): Understand how BIP39 seed phrases work: converting private keys to memorable words. Learn the 2048-word list and how seeds protect your Bitcoin.
- [Extended Private Key (XPRV)](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/xprv.md): Practical guide: Extended Private Key (XPRV). Covers Why the Extended Private Key Matters, Security Considerations, Generating and Testing an Extended Private.
- [Extended Public Key (XPUB)](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/xpub.md): Practical guide: Extended Public Key (XPUB). Covers Security Considerations, Identifying Extended Public Keys, Final Thoughts.
- [Derivation Path](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/derivation-path.md): Practical guide: Derivation Path. Covers The BIP32 Standard, Anatomy of a Derivation Path, Common Derivation Paths.
- [Bitcoin Passphrase (25th Word): Diceware Generation](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/passphrase.md): Learn what a Bitcoin passphrase is, when to use it, and how to generate a strong one with dice and the EFF word list. Full 3-step DIY guide.
- [Generate Your Own Bitcoin Seed Phrase with Dice](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/random.md): Generate a BIP39 Bitcoin seed phrase from dice rolls. True randomness, verifiable checksum, fully offline, no need to trust the wallet RNG.
- [Number Systems: Binary, Decimal, Hex](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/keys/number-systems.md): Understand binary, decimal, and hexadecimal number systems used in Bitcoin private keys. Essential foundation for understanding seed phrases.
- [Bitcoin Wallets: Hardware, Software, Air-Gapped, Multisig](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets.md): Bitcoin wallet types compared: hardware wallets, software wallets, air-gapped setups, and multisig vaults. Pick the right security model for your needs.
- [Software Wallets Explained](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/software-wallets.md): Understand software wallets for Bitcoin: what they are, when to use them, recommended options, and security best practices.
- [Hardware Wallets Explained](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/hardware-wallets.md): Understand hardware wallets for Bitcoin self-custody: how they work, why they're secure, popular options compared, and how to choose the right one.
- [Air-Gapped Wallets: Complete Guide](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/air-gapped-wallets.md): Understand and build a Bitcoin air-gapped wallet. Concepts, hardware options (laptop, Raspberry Pi, desktop), and a full step-by-step air-gapped computer setup.
- [Coldcard Entropy Incident: What Happened, Who's Affected](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/coldcard-entropy-incident.md): The 2026 Coldcard entropy flaw explained: which devices and firmware are affected, how $116M was stolen, and how to migrate your funds safely.
- [Bitcoin Multisig: Complete Guide](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/multisig.md): Understand and set up a Bitcoin multisig wallet. Concepts, 2-of-3 configurations, hardware devices, and a full step-by-step setup guide.
- [Multisig Hardware Setup](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/multisig/hardware-setup.md): Prepare your hardware wallets for multisig. Learn how to initialize signing devices from different manufacturers for maximum security.
- [Multisig in Sparrow Wallet](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/multisig/sparrow-setup.md): Step-by-step guide to creating a 2-of-3 multisig wallet in Sparrow. Learn to configure your multisig, verify addresses, and make transactions.
- [Multisig Backup & Recovery](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/wallets/multisig/backup-recovery.md): How to properly backup your multisig wallet and recover it if needed. Critical information for protecting your bitcoin long-term.
- [Bitcoin Transactions: How They Work](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions.md): How Bitcoin transactions work end to end: UTXOs, transaction creation, signing, broadcasting, fees, and the transaction types you will actually encounter.
- [UTXOs Explained](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/utxos.md): Understand Bitcoin's UTXO model. Learn how Unspent Transaction Outputs work, why Bitcoin isn't an account balance, and how UTXOs affect fees and privacy.
- [How Bitcoin Transactions Work](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/understanding.md): Understand how Bitcoin transactions work: inputs, outputs, change, fees, and the complete lifecycle from creation to confirmation.
- [How Bitcoin Transactions Are Created](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/create.md): Practical guide: Creation. Covers Manually Building Transactions, Using Wallets to Send Transactions, RBF – Replace-by-Fee.
- [How Bitcoin Transaction Signing Works](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/sign.md): How Bitcoin transaction signing works: what signing means, online vs offline signing flows, and single-sig versus multisig signing.
- [How to Broadcast a Bitcoin Transaction](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/broadcast.md): Practical guide: Broadcasting. Covers Broadcasting via Your Own Node vs. Third-Party Servers, Privacy Considerations, bitcoin.
- [Bitcoin Transaction Fees Explained](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/fees.md): Understand how Bitcoin transaction fees work, why they vary, and how to minimize costs. Learn fee estimation, RBF, CPFP, and fee optimization strategies.
- [Bitcoin Transaction Types Explained](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/transactions/types.md): Bitcoin transaction types explained: pre-signed, fully signed, and partially signed (PSBT). When each type is used and how they differ.
- [Bitcoin Privacy: Chain Analysis, CoinJoin, UTXO Control](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy.md): Bitcoin privacy fundamentals: what is exposed on the public blockchain, how chain analysis works, and how CoinJoin and UTXO control protect you.
- [Why Bitcoin Privacy Matters](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/why-privacy-matters.md): Why financial privacy matters for Bitcoin users. What information is exposed on the public blockchain and how it affects your security.
- [Chain Analysis Explained](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/chain-analysis.md): Learn how blockchain surveillance works. Understand the heuristics and techniques used to track Bitcoin transactions and link addresses to identities.
- [Protecting Your Privacy](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/protecting-privacy.md): Overview of Bitcoin privacy techniques. Learn the principles and methods for protecting your financial privacy when using Bitcoin.
- [Bitcoin UTXO Management: Coin Control & Consolidation Guide](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/utxo-management.md): Bitcoin UTXO management for lower fees and better privacy. Coin control in Sparrow, consolidation strategies, dusting attacks, and source separation rules.
- [Bitcoin CoinJoin: How It Works & Best Practices](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/coinjoin.md): How Bitcoin CoinJoin works: equal outputs, anonymity sets, the 2026 tools (JoinMarket NG, Jam, Ashigaru Whirlpool, Wasabi), and post-mix rules.
- [CoinJoin Tutorial: JoinMarket NG and Jam Step by Step](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/coinjoin-tutorial.md): Step-by-step Bitcoin coinjoin with JoinMarket NG and Jam: your own node, a dedicated hot wallet, funding, mixing rounds, and sweeping out cleanly.
- [Bitcoin PayJoin (BIP78): Stealth Privacy for Payments](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/privacy/payjoin.md): Learn how PayJoin (BIP78) enhances Bitcoin privacy by breaking the common-input-ownership assumption. Set up PayJoin with Sparrow Wallet and BTCPay Server.
- [Bitcoin Nodes: What They Are and Why They Matter](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/nodes.md): What Bitcoin nodes do, why running your own matters for self-custody, and how a personal node verifies every transaction without trusting third parties.
- [What is a Bitcoin Node](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/nodes/what-is-node.md): Understand what a Bitcoin node does, how it differs from a wallet, and its role in the network. Essential knowledge before running your own node.
- [Why Run Your Own Node](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/learn/nodes/why-run-node.md): Understand why running your own Bitcoin node matters for privacy, security, and true self-custody. Learn the risks of using third-party nodes.

- [Using SeedSigner: Seeds, SeedQR, and Signing](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/seedsigner/using-seedsigner.md): Generate a seed with dice on your SeedSigner, back it up as a SeedQR, and sign transactions with Sparrow over an air-gapped QR workflow.

## Nostr Signing Device

- [Build a Nostr Signing Device (NSD)](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/nostr-signing-device/.md): Build your own Nostr Signing Device to keep your private key secure. Hardware-based signing for Nostr using LILYGO T-Display and Horse extension.
- [Arduino IDE Setup for NSD](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/nostr-signing-device/arduino-ide.md): Install and configure Arduino IDE to flash your Nostr Signing Device. Download the legacy version and set up ESP32 board support.
- [ESP32 Board Support Setup](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/nostr-signing-device/esp32-module.md): Add ESP32 board support to Arduino IDE so you can compile and flash firmware for the LILYGO T-Display module used by the Nostr Signing Device.
- [Prepare the NSD Firmware](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/nostr-signing-device/setup.md): Clone the NSD repository and flash the firmware to your LILYGO device. Step-by-step instructions to prepare your Nostr Signing Device.
- [Install Horse Browser Extension](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/nostr-signing-device/horse-extension.md): Install the Horse Chromium browser extension to connect your Nostr Signing Device to web clients and sign Nostr events from your browser.
- [Connect NSD to Nostr Clients](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/nostr-signing-device/client-connect.md): Connect your Nostr Signing Device to clients like Coracle and NoStrudel. Final step to start using your hardware-secured Nostr identity.

## Libreboot

- [Libreboot Installation Guide](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/.md): Install Libreboot open-source firmware to replace your BIOS. Remove Intel ME backdoors and enhance security for your Bitcoin computer.
- [Libreboot Hardware Requirements](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/requirements.md): Hardware list for flashing Libreboot: supported laptops, Raspberry Pi Pico H programmer, Pomona SOIC8 clip, and required cables.
- [Build Libreboot](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/build.md): Build a Libreboot ROM from source on Linux: install dependencies, clone the lbmk repository, and run a multi-threaded compile.
- [Build Libreboot ROM Images](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/roms.md): Generate Libreboot ROM images for your specific laptop model. Compile custom BIOS firmware using the lbmk build system, ready to flash.
- [Build Flashprog for Libreboot](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/build-flashprog.md): Compile Flashprog from the Libreboot build system. Required tool for reading and writing BIOS chips during Libreboot installation.
- [Prepare a Raspberry Pi Pico for Libreboot Flashing](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/raspberry-pico.md): Set up a Raspberry Pi Pico H as an SPI programmer for flashing Libreboot: build the serprog firmware and wire the Pico to your laptop's BIOS chip.
- [Build Serprog](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/raspberry-pico/build-serprog.md): Build serprog firmware for the Raspberry Pi Pico H so it can act as an SPI programmer for flashing Libreboot to a laptop chip.
- [Pico-Pomona Clip Connection](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/raspberry-pico/connection.md): Practical guide: Pico-Pomona Clip Connection. Covers The Bios Chip, PIN Map on Raspberry Pico, Models X230, T420, T430, T440p and T480s.
- [Flash Libreboot to Your Laptop BIOS](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/flashing-bios.md): Flash a Libreboot ROM onto your laptop with an external SPI programmer: locate the chips, split the ROM, detect, and write the new firmware.
- [Update Libreboot Firmware](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/libreboot/update-bios.md): Practical guide: Update. Covers Disable security protections before flashing, Flash Chip Size, Read the Current Chip Contents.

## Coreboot

- [Coreboot Installation Guide](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/.md): Install Coreboot open-source firmware for a fast, secure, and transparent boot process. Perfect for Bitcoin nodes and security-focused setups.
- [Coreboot Hardware Requirements](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/requirements.md): Practical guide: Requirements. Covers Internal Flashing, External Flashing, bitcoin.
- [Build Coreboot](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/build.md): Practical guide: Build Coreboot. Covers Step 1: Install tools and libraries needed for coreboot, Step 2: Download Coreboot Source Tree, Step 3: Build the.
- [Internal Coreboot Flashing](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/internal.md): Flash Coreboot from inside a running system: downgrade your stock BIOS, unlock the Intel Flash Descriptor, and write the new firmware safely.
- [Downgrading BIOS](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/internal/downgrading-bios.md): Downgrade your laptop's stock BIOS to a version with an unlocked Intel ME region, a prerequisite for internal Coreboot flashing.
- [Unlocking BIOS](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/internal/unlocking-bios.md): Unlock the Intel Flash Descriptor BIOS region with CHIPSEC so Coreboot can be flashed internally without an external SPI programmer.
- [Flash Coreboot to Your Laptop BIOS](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/internal/flashing-bios.md): Flash Coreboot from inside a running system after the BIOS region is unlocked. Includes safety checks and verification of the flashed image.
- [External Flashing](https://selfcustodylabs.com/docs/coreboot/external-flashing.md): Practical guide: External Flashing. Covers Detect the Chip, Backup the Factory Bios, Neutralize Intel ME.
